items.title: PAN-OS GlobalProtect Authentication Bypass (CVE-2026-0257) Under Active Exploitation
items.description: Palo Alto Networks has warned that a recently disclosed medium-severity security flaw impacting PAN-OS and Prisma Access has come under active exploitation in the wild. items.title: GREYVIBE Hackers Leverage ChatGPT and Google Gemini to Fuel Cyberattacks
